runner_slots.meaning: One ephemeral GitHub Actions job environment; not a credential slot and not one logical agent
runner_slots.limit_source: Current pool design ceiling; actual account concurrency and GitHub limits must be rechecked before deployment

agent_workloads.resource_source: Measured workload peak plus explicit safety reserve; unknown envelopes are not eligible for co-location
agent_workloads.shared_runtime_disk: Count a pinned immutable runtime bundle once per runner slot and digest; retain per-agent scratch disk
agent_workloads.multiple_functions: Functions may share one agent workload reservation when they execute within the same runtime process
agent_workloads.multiple_agents: Distinct agent workloads may share a runner only when all placement and isolation checks pass

co_location_requirements: same platform, architecture, network_class and workspace_isolation
not exclusive; independent reviewers and security auditors are exclusive by default
each workload has measured CPU, RAM and scratch-disk reservations
runtime bundle is pinned by SHA-256 digest
required capabilities are available on the runner template

credential_boundary.gateway_scope: Per-workload short-lived capability; never share one agent's credential context with another agent
credential_boundary.gateway_scope_id: Required opaque non-secret handle; unique per workload; never the token or API key

isolation.workspace: Separate working directory and per-workload scratch space
isolation.runtime_bundle: Immutable read-only shared bundle may be mounted once per digest
isolation.process: Separate process or container per workload; no shared environment files
isolation.trust: Never co-locate different task trust domains or independent review with implementation
isolation.host: Ephemeral runner; destroy after the GitHub Actions job

failure_policy.unknown_resource_envelope: reject co-location; require measurement or isolated fallback
failure_policy.resource_overflow: create another runner slot up to the pool cap; otherwise leave queued

separation_from_credential_slots.active_credential_slot_limit_applies_to: Provider credential route leases only, not agents or runner slots
